decisions.reason: The illuminated candle arch with sound builds on the firm's established wooden Christmas-decoration know-how, and its home-page placement suggests enough first-season promise for management to keep learning and refine the electronic add-on rather than withdraw it quickly.

The arched one-tier Christmas pyramid is very close to the firm's core capabilities in traditional wooden festive products, so absorptive capacity is high and there is little reason to drop it after only one season.

The electronic music box with interchangeable discs is somewhat more novel because of the electronics and modular concept, but it still rests on related product knowledge and was featured prominently enough to justify continued development.

The motif platform for the electronic music box is a niche complement rather than a flagship item, yet it leverages the firm's learning around product C and is therefore still more likely to be retained than discontinued.

The Christmas motif platform for the music box fits the firm's seasonal design strengths and complements the broader music-box line, so management would likely keep it while assessing another sales cycle.

The Christmas pyramid with Dresden theme is a close extension of the firm's traditional wooden pyramid expertise and its home-page visibility indicates sufficient early value to remain in the assortment.
